text:
mara: Heads-up: canary rollout to eu-west failed — pods crashloop on start, logs show missing env var REDWOOD_S3_KEY. CI job says secret not found in kustomize overlay.

devon: Looking now. CI shows sealedsecret entry exists but `kubectl describe` returns secret not found. @ci-bot shows last sealedsecret apply at 1748990000.

sophia: We rotated the SOPS key last night. We also switched the private clusters to Vault agent for new deploys — possible mismatch between overlays.

mara: Confirmed: gitops overlay for dedicated/eu-west still references `sops/encrypted-s3.yaml`. We intended to migrate to `vault/csi` but the overlay switch wasn't merged.

jen: Can we fallback to an older sealed-secret until overlay is migrated? That might be fastest.

devon: SealedSecrets controller in eu-west was upgraded to v0.23 in Jan; it requires a different controller cert format. Rolling back would risk other clusters. Safer to inject secret temporarily.

sophia: Quick mitigation: run an ephemeral CI runner in eu-west to pull the secret from Vault and `kubectl create secret generic` into the namespace. Not ideal, but low blast radius.

mara: CI runners with cluster creds live in us-east. We'd need a runner in eu-west or use our bastion to reach the cluster.

ops-bot: incident-note: created ticket INF-4237 — 'eu-west secret distribution fail'

devon: I can spin up an ephemeral runner in eu-west. Plan: vault login -> read secret -> kubectl create secret. Example command I will use: `vault kv get -field=REDWOOD_S3_KEY secret/redwood/prod` then `kubectl create secret generic redwood-s3 --from-literal=REDWOOD_S3_KEY=... -n redwood`. I'll post full steps once ready.

jen: Remember not to commit plaintext secrets. If possible, seal it with `kubeseal` and commit sealed secret to GitOps repo. But we need the controller cert to generate sealed secret for eu-west.

devon: I don't have controller cert for eu-west locally; fetching it requires cluster access. That's why ephemeral runner/bastion is easier for immediate fix.

sophia: Longer term: migrate the overlay to Vault CSI driver + VaultAgent sidecar for injection, and deprecate SOPS sealed files for dedicated clusters. Also add an annotation `redwood.org/secret-source: vault` for clarity.

mara: Agreed. Action items: temporary secret injection -> patch overlay pointing to vault -> pipeline guard to prevent overlay drift. Devon, take the temporary injection and post commands here.

devon: Executing mitigation now. Commands used: `vault login -method=github token=${VAULT_TOKEN}`; `export KEY=$(vault kv get -field=REDWOOD_S3_KEY secret/redwood/prod)`; `kubectl create secret generic redwood-s3 --from-literal=REDWOOD_S3_KEY=\"$KEY\" -n redwood`. Canary resumed after injection.

jen: If you can, also run `kubeseal --cert controller.crt < s3-secret.json > sealed.json` and commit sealed.json to the gitops repo to make the change durable, then follow up by switching to vault in a PR.

devon: Pushed a mitigation note and resumed canary. Opening PR for overlay change now: https://git.redwood.com/redwood/gitops/pulls/512

sophia: Please include a pipeline pre-check that verifies decrypted secret presence before applying overlay. Example: run `kubectl get secret redwood-s3 -n redwood --ignore-not-found` and fail the job if missing.

jen: Also add a terraform check: ensure sealedsecrets controller cert rotation status and version parity across regions so controller cert mismatch doesn't block sealed secret creation.

sophia: Add metrics/alerts: `secret_missing_count{cluster="eu-west"}` and alert when >0 for 5m.

mara: Thanks everyone. INF-4237 updated with mitigation. I'll write a short postmortem with action items: overlay migration, pipeline guard, sealedsecrets/ctrl parity check, and metrics.

ops-bot: update INF-4237: mitigation applied, canary resumed (created by devon)

devon: Canary healthy. Will monitor for 30m then close incident.

mara: Small blip but good catch. After PR merges, let's run a cross-region audit to find any other overlays still pointing to sops files.

jen: I'll add a CI job that scans gitops overlays for `sops/` references and fails with link to migration docs.

sophia: I'll handle the VaultAgent Helm values and a rollout doc for platform teams.

mara: Postmortem TODOs assigned. Closing conversation here, keep updates in INF-4237 thread. :white_check_mark:
